The safety profile of fluoroquinolones. While they are very useful agents, fluoroquinolones (FQs) are associated with a number of serious adverse effects (AEs). The objective of this paper is to describe the characteristics of frequent serious AEs related to FQs along with their risk factors, their safety in specific populations, and the main drug-drug interactions that may occur.
